Via Aramaic תִּיגָרָא (tīḡārā), from the Middle Persian ancestor of Persian تغار (taġâr). The variant טנגירא / ܛܢܓܝܪܐ (ṭangīrā) from the ancestor of تنگیره (tangire) is present as طَنْجِير (ṭanjīr), طَنْجِيرَة (ṭanjīra), طَنْجَر (ṭanjar), and طَنْجَرَة (ṭanjara).
Borrowed from Aramaic גּוּדָא (guddā) / ܓܘܢܕܐ (gundā), from Middle Persian gwnd (gund, “army, troop”).

parole.significato: Melilotus, melilot, sweet clover, sour clover
